method: Chrome DevTools MCP. Instrumentation installed before navigation; each trial uses a new isolated browser context. No concurrent task-owned tests, builds, browser audits or compression. Native API and browser process remain warm.
limitations: Local native fixture API, not deployed backend load
Tool trace summaries and browser entries; no raw trace retained
Lab INP is not field INP
Native comparison fixture has empty parameter/scalar panels; populated comparison timings use a separate unthrottled harness
navigationReadiness: Known task node must be CSS-visible with positive measured dimensions, then two animation frames. Updated before any navigation trial; no timing observation uses the old node-presence-only predicate.
observerSnapshot: Paint observations are captured after fonts readiness; observedAtMs records the endpoint.
filterControls: Legacy textbox Filter runs / input#tableFilterBox and modern searchbox Filter runs by name. Same four-row precondition, xgboost value, input event and one-row/two-frame endpoint.

discardedAttempts.reason: Automation expected the modern searchbox accessible name before interacting with the legacy textbox. No filter interaction or measurement occurred; corrected legacy control lookup and reran in a fresh context.
